purpose: [OPTIMIZED] Resolves a specific list of compact IDs to their full names.
parameters: ``ids`` (array of strings, required): specific list of compact module or artifact IDs to decode.
``allow_large_output`` (boolean, default ``false``): override to approve emission of outputs exceeding the 15 KiB warning threshold.
behavior:
Resolves a caller-supplied list of compact IDs without any fixed ID-count limit.
Output <= 15 KiB (15360 UTF-8 bytes) returns the resolved identity mapping normally.
Output > 15 KiB with ``allow_large_output=false`` acts as an agent-controlled context
safety preflight and returns ``status: 'confirmation_required'`` with exact predicted
serialized byte size and retry instructions. The warning deliberately does not echo
IDs or resolved entries, ensuring the preflight response itself remains compact.
Passing ``allow_large_output=true`` returns the complete lossless resolved mapping.
usage_notes:
LLM use: pass only IDs visible in the current result instead of loading the
full project dictionary. Recovery means a known historical identity and
must not be presented as an active symbol; missing means no known identity.
When a request exceeds 15 KiB, inspect ``estimated_output_bytes`` and decide
whether the context cost is acceptable; to approve, repeat the same call with the
same repo_path and ids and set ``allow_large_output=True``.
examples:
Use this instead of get_project_index when you only need to decode a
handful of IDs found in a report (e.g. from module_dependency_matrix or
shared_usage_clusters).  Much cheaper than loading the entire registry.

Accepts both module IDs (e.g. '124/1') and artifact IDs (e.g. 'A35/1').
Each ID resolves to ``{"name": ..., "status": "active|recovery|missing"}``
so stale identities are distinguishable from malformed or unknown IDs.
